paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: renders AGENTS.md as an independent system-prompt section, re-read on every
prompt assembly instead of injected as user messages.
# dsh-agents-section
Render `AGENTS.md` as its own **system-prompt section** for DeepSeek Harness — re-read on every prom
pt assembly, instead of being pasted in as a user message.
## What it does
Project instructions (`AGENTS.md`) normally reach the model by being injected as a **user message**.
This plugin registers them as a standalone **system-prompt section** instead:
- **Independent section** — the text lives in the system prompt under its own name, at its own `orde

r`, not inside the user turn.
- **Re-read on every assembly** — the section body is a function, so `
AGENTS.md` is read from disk each time the prompt is assembled. Edit the file and the next turn alre

ady sees the change; no restart, no cache to bust.
- **Per-session resolution** — the same config se
rves every workspace. A bare file name is resolved against the **session's own working directory**,

so a session in one repo never picks up another repo's instructions.
- **Nothing to render, nothing
added** — when no configured file applies to a session, the section is empty.

## Configuration
The row is `agents-section`; its config is live-editable at Settings → Plugins:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Option | Default | Meaning |
| `order` | `400` | Position of the section in the assembled system prompt (lower comes earlier). |

| `sectionName` | `agents:instructions` | Name the section is registered under. |
| `files` | `[]` |
Instruction files to render, in order. See below. |
### `files` entries
Entries come in two shapes:
- **Absolute path** (`C:\\repo\\AGENTS.md`, `/home/me/AGENTS.md`) — rendered for **every** session,

regardless of where it runs. Useful for machine-wide house rules.
- **Bare file name** (`AGENTS.md`,
`CONTRIBUTING.md`) — resolved **per session** against that session's working directory. The plugin
walks upward from the working directory until it finds a directory containing `.git` (the project ro
ot) and renders the file from every directory on the way down. So a session in `repo/packages/api` g
ets `repo/AGENTS.md` *and* `repo/packages/api/AGENTS.md`; a session in a sibling workspace gets neit
`repo/AGENTS.md` *and* `repo/packages/api/AGENTS.md`; a session in a sibling workspace gets neither.
Missing, unreadable, or blank files are skipped silently. Each rendered block is prefixed with its o
wn path, so the model can tell two files apart.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with a profile that mounts `dsh-system-prompt`.
- Node 20+.
The `@deepseek-ai/*` packages are supplied by the DSH installation itself and are declared as option
al peers, so no second copy is installed.
## Notes
- This plugin only adds the section. To avoid the model receiving the same instructions twice, disab
le the built-in user-message injection (the `agent-instructions` rows' `maxBytes: 0`) when you rely

on this section.
- The project-root marker is `.git` only. A workspace without a `.git` directory st
ill works: the chain is then just the session's own directory.
